description: The five asthma loci in v1 scope, as report section 7 lists them. pipeline/report_lib/ancestry.py counts genome-wide-significant associations at these loci by the broad ancestral category of the discovery sample (T11).
scope_source: data/diseases/asthma.json genetic_architecture.top_loci, plus the two partner genes the locus labels name (GSDMB at 17q12-21, IL13 at 5q31).
selection_rule: An association is assigned to a locus when any symbol in the GWAS Catalog's own MAPPED_GENE cell for that association equals one of the locus's gene_symbols, compared case-sensitively after splitting the cell on its separators and trimming. MAPPED_GENE is the catalog's gene annotation, so the match is against a curated identifier and never against free text in a trait or study title. REPORTED GENE(S) is deliberately not used: it carries the authors' own wording, which is not a controlled field. No genomic window is applied, because a window needs a genome build the extract does not state per row.
significance_note: P-VALUE strictly less than 5e-8, the conventional genome-wide significance threshold. The threshold is a convention for declaring an association, not a measure of effect size, and nothing here reports an effect estimate (CONTEXT.md X7).

loci.label: 17q12-21 (ORMDL3/GSDMB)
loci.note: The strongest and most replicated asthma locus in the atlas record. ORMDL3 is the gene data/diseases/asthma.json names; GSDMB sits in the same linkage-disequilibrium block and the locus is conventionally labelled by both.

loci.label: IL33
loci.note: The gene at the head of the five-step mechanism chain the report states.

loci.label: 5q31 (RAD50/IL13)
loci.note: RAD50 is the gene data/diseases/asthma.json names; IL13 is adjacent and the locus is conventionally labelled by both.
